name: Heracles's Olive-Club
lore: Uprooted from the wild olives of Nemea by the hero's own hands, hardened in the fire of his second labor. The Nemean Lion's hide had turned every blade he tried; the club did not need to cut. The wood is dark with old work and smells of resin even now.
curve_note: base_damage = curve.weapon_base_damage(46) x 2.0 unique-mult, signature boss-tier hero weapon. Class: heavy 5-rung [0.75, 0.90, 1.00, 1.30, 1.75]. F40-49 Medusa-era band fill.
